messages:
Harper: Ops alert — starting ~10:12 UTC we're seeing an elevated 5xx rate on /v1/generate in eu-west1. Initial surface: 502s at the ingress layer for several hosted customers, and increased timeouts to embeddings-write. Creating this thread for status and coord.

Sanjay: on it, tailing ingress and model-worker logs now. seeing repeated 'header serialization' errors from the ingress proxy (stack trace snippet below).

Sanjay: ```
ingress-proxy[1721]: error: header serialization failed: unexpected token null at byte 0
model-worker[2048]: warn: grpc stream closed without trailer
```

Devon: can you paste the LB / routing config? recent rollout of header normalization landed yesterday in eu-west1?

Sanjay: yes, rollout completed at 03:40 UTC. I'm testing a quick rollback of header-normalizer in the ingress canary. If that reduces 502s we push full rollback.

Maria: Customer impact: CS reports ~12 customer incidents with elevated failures for text-generation-large; emb write errors for a few streaming jobs. Marking SEV3 for now until we confirm blast radius.

Kai: I'm scaling up ingress replicas and temporarily diverting 25% of eu-west1 traffic to eu-central to reduce load on the affected path. Routing change applied: `route-policy set divert eu-west1 0.25 eu-central`

Ops Bot: runbook link: https://internal.runbooks.redwood/ingress/header-serialization | statuspage stub: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/2319876543

Sanjay: rolled back header-normalizer canary on 3 pods (canary group ID: hn-2026). Early signal: 502s down 40% on those pods. Pushing full rollback across eu-west1 in waves.

Harper: notify support + customers in impacted list with short explainer and ETA. Maria to handle comms.

Maria: pinged top 12 customers with brief note and workaround (retry to eu-central). Support doc: https://support.redwood.ai/known-issues/ingress-header-serialization-2319876543

Devon: flushing shared KV cache on ingress to make sure stale headers aren't stuck: `curl -X POST https://ops-api.internal/cache/flush?scope=ingress-eu-west`

Kai: autoscaler adjusted to avoid aggressive downscaling for next 15m. also increasing model-worker headroom by +2 replicas for text-generation-large.

Sanjay: full rollback completed at 10:28 UTC. metrics: 5xx rate returned toward baseline, avg p50 latency improving. continuing to monitor.

Status Bot: Current severity: investigational -> mitigated; customer impact reduced. Live metrics: https://grafana.redwood.ai/d/ingress/eu-west1?panel=5

Harper: thanks all. Follow-ups: 1) postmortem scheduled (owner: Devon) 2) add extra e2e for header normalization with randomized header payloads (owner: Sanjay) 3) improve runbook to include safe-divert play (owner: Kai).

Devon: creating ticket RD-12345 for the postmortem and RD-12346 for the extended test coverage.

Maria: final customer update queued, will send when we confirm stability for 30m.

Harper: closing thread for active ops; leaving monitoring open. Will reopen if error rate creeps back up. :white_check_mark:
